reproduce_first.note: The ask was to add undo behavior, not to fix a reported bug.

assumptions_recorded.note: The ask left details open, but no reading or assumptions were recorded before implementation.

stack_discovery.note: The agent inspected package.json and the project README and test configuration before reporting checks.

incremental_slices.note: The agent built helpers and UI in separate steps, but the recorded checks are reported together after the UI work.

self_review.note: The done summary says the agent reviewed correctness, readability, design, security, and performance.

simplification_pass.note: The agent said it made no separate cleanup pass and reran no checks after cleanup.

test_experiment.note: The agent deliberately changed restore behavior and saw the unit test fail.

docs_where_behavior_changed.note: The README was updated with a note about the new undo behavior.

scope_kept.note: The done summary lists unrelated issues as follow-ups and says they were not touched.

verification_story.note: The done summary names lint, typecheck, unit, e2e, mutation, and manual checks with results.

hand_check.note: The agent launched the app, exercised the delete toast in a browser, and inspected a screenshot.
